files.source: Euro foreign exchange reference rates of the European Central Bank (ecb.europa.eu, eurofxref-hist.zip) (ECB series: EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.MXN.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.BRL.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.ZAR.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.KRW.EUR.SP00.A, EXR.D.INR.EUR.SP00.A).
